title: Extension Pricing Option
description: A pricing option whose model an extension defines. pricing_model is the branch id (extension uri '#' branch name); extension_model carries the model's data, validated by that extension. A buyer that does not understand the branch cannot buy the option: it drops the option with a warning and keeps the product's other options (unknown_in_list: drop_option). A seller MUST NOT send the option to a caller that did not list the extension in understood_extensions. fixed_price and floor_price are absent: the model defines how the price is set. The branch's registration names the core model whose delivery metric and spend semantics apply in reporting (reports_as).

pricing_option_id.description: Unique identifier for this pricing option within the product

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Budgets and spend stay in this currency.

extensions.description: Explanatory extension data for this option, as on core-model options.
